assumptions: Twenty-one coordinates serialize nine episodes and selected ordering without estimating calendar, diplomatic or military duration.
Eight organizational Agents retain supported choices; four unknown/passive source participants remain context and no victim Population is invented.
Organizational representation gates do not imply unitary members, stable preferences, command hierarchy, legal identity or continuous strategy.
All baseline routes use one logical tick; delivered-message guards are construction choices, not recovered intelligence or diplomatic channels.
Violent and intervention rows are qualified records with no tactic, casualty, territory, weapon, finance, aid or victory effect.
Outcome expectations are descriptive; evidence integrity and terminal transport, not endpoint matching, control release.
